name: @playliquid/tool-fabric-runtime
description: PlayLiquid GameOS Tool Fabric runtime (PL-019): the runtime side of the Tool Fabric contracts — a tool/engine adapter registry with deterministic request resolution, an invocation pipeline over the tool-fabric call protocol (surface mediation, capability mediation, manifest shape validation), a content-addressed artifact exchange guard (no inline bytes), a queued/resumable job model with typed status transitions, and pure executor/clock ports with the node process adapter and in-memory fakes behind them. Provider-neutral: no engine SDKs, no engine types, no IO in the domain.
